title: Booking emails state the time in the booker's own time zone

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: the picker shows times in the viewer's zone, but every email formats in the Space's zone (bookingTimezone). A booker in New York reads 'Tue 9:00 AM PST'. Fix: store the zone the browser reported at booking (space_bookings.booker_time_zone, additive) and use it for the booker's mails; the owner's mails keep the Space zone.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
